notes.title: Valentine's Update!
notes.notes:
Now that the dust has settled.
One final QOL update for NENA before I move on to new things...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38744242/1ddca13cf53e705c73d48a336847b6e6480648de.jpg


 Graphics rendering has been redone for better performance!
 Lighting system overhauled. Now we have some pretty B L O O M
 Small bug fixes!
 Added a new secret...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38744242/1c2b75e3c8f6cbbf7849a55b35c7f40de5dcd9b3.jpg

Now that this update is done. I will be moving on to other projects. Working on NENA has been one of the greatest experiences of my life and I'm so happy to share it with each and every one of you.

One more thing...
There will be ONE last NENA related announcement. Sometime this month... Stay tuned!!!

For those who reached the ending, thank you for being a part of our journey <3
